تتعاهدي (form VI)
# تَتَعَاهَدِي (tataʕāhadī) /ta.ta.ʕaː.ha.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُتَعَاهَدِي (tutaʕāhadī) /tu.ta.ʕaː.ha.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
